# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Office API — Presentation API

> A presentation document has a more simple structure than that of a document, most of the presentation elements are nested within the slide element with all the other elements placed on it. The single or multiple slide elements are a part of the presentation element.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. This file covers one part of the [section index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/llms.txt); for the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Presentation API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api.md): A presentation document has a more simple structure than that of a document, most of the presentation elements are nested within the slide element with all the other elements placed on it. The single or multiple slide elements are a part of the presentation element.

## Api

- [Api](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api.md): The main class of the Presentation API. Use it to get the current presentation and to create slides and slide elements, such as shapes, images, tables, and charts.
- [Api.CentimetersToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CentimetersToPoints.md): Converts centimeters to points.
- [Api.Color](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/Color.md): Creates an ApiColor from a universal input.
- [Api.CreateBlipFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateBlipFill.md): Creates a blip fill to apply to the object using the selected image as the object background.
- [Api.CreateBullet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateBullet.md): Creates a bullet for a paragraph with the character or symbol specified with the sSymbol parameter.
- [Api.CreateChart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateChart.md): Creates a chart with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateCustomGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateCustomGeometry.md): Creates a new custom geometry.
- [Api.CreateGradientStop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateGradientStop.md): Creates a gradient stop used for different types of gradients.
- [Api.CreateGroup](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateGroup.md): Creates a group of drawings.
- [Api.CreateHyperlink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateHyperlink.md): Creates a new hyperlink object to be used for setting hyperlinks on drawing objects (shapes or images).
- [Api.CreateImage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateImage.md): Creates an image with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateLayout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateLayout.md): Creates a new slide layout and adds it to the slide master if it is specified.
- [Api.CreateLinearGradientFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateLinearGradientFill.md): Creates a linear gradient fill to apply to the object using the selected linear gradient as the object background.
- [Api.CreateMaster](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateMaster.md): Creates a new slide master.
- [Api.CreateMath](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateMath.md): Creates a math equation from a linear text string. The resulting object can be inserted into a paragraph the same way as a run (e.g. via ApiParagraph#AddElement or ApiParagraph#Push).
- [Api.CreateNoFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateNoFill.md): Creates no fill and removes the fill from the element.
- [Api.CreateNumbering](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateNumbering.md): Creates a bullet for a paragraph with the numbering character or symbol specified with the numType parameter.
- [Api.CreateOleObject](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateOleObject.md): Creates an OLE object with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateParagraph.md): Creates a new paragraph.
- [Api.CreatePatternFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreatePatternFill.md): Creates a pattern fill to apply to the object using the selected pattern as the object background.
- [Api.CreatePlaceholder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreatePlaceholder.md): Creates a new placeholder.
- [Api.CreatePresetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreatePresetColor.md): Creates a color selecting it from one of the available color presets.
- [Api.CreatePresetGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreatePresetGeometry.md): Creates a geometry using one of the available preset shapes.
- [Api.CreateRGBColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateRGBColor.md): Creates an RGB color setting the appropriate values for the red, green and blue color components.
- [Api.CreateRadialGradientFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateRadialGradientFill.md): Creates a radial gradient fill to apply to the object using the selected radial gradient as the object background.
- [Api.CreateRun](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateRun.md): Creates a new smaller text block to be inserted to the current paragraph or table.
- [Api.CreateSchemeColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateSchemeColor.md): Creates a complex color scheme selecting from one of the available schemes.
- [Api.CreateShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateShadow.md): Creates a shadow which can be applied to a graphic object.
- [Api.CreateShape](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateShape.md): Creates a shape with the parameters specified.
- [Api.CreateShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateShd.md): Creates the shading which can be applied to text, a paragraph, a table or a table cell.
- [Api.CreateSlide](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateSlide.md): Creates a new slide.
- [Api.CreateSlideShowTransition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateSlideShowTransition.md): Creates a new slide show transition object.
- [Api.CreateSolidFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateSolidFill.md): Creates a solid fill to apply to the object using a selected solid color as the object background.
- [Api.CreateStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateStroke.md): Creates a stroke adding shadows to the element.
- [Api.CreateTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateTable.md): Creates a table.
- [Api.CreateTablePr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateTablePr.md): Creates the empty table properties.
- [Api.CreateTableRowPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateTableRowPr.md): Creates the empty table row properties.
- [Api.CreateTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateTextPr.md): Creates the empty text properties.
- [Api.CreateTheme](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateTheme.md): Creates a new presentation theme.
- [Api.CreateThemeColorScheme](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateThemeColorScheme.md): Creates a new theme color scheme.
- [Api.CreateThemeFontScheme](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateThemeFontScheme.md): Creates a new theme font scheme.
- [Api.CreateThemeFormatScheme](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateThemeFormatScheme.md): Creates a new theme format scheme.
- [Api.CreateWordArt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/CreateWordArt.md): Creates a Text Art object with the parameters specified.
- [Api.EmusToMillimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/EmusToMillimeters.md): Converts English Metric Units (EMUs) to millimeters.
- [Api.EmusToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/EmusToPoints.md): Converts EMUs (English Metric Units) to points.
- [Api.FromJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/FromJSON.md): Converts the specified JSON object into the Document Builder object of the corresponding type.
- [Api.GetFirstSlide](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/GetFirstSlide.md): Returns the first slide of the presentation.
- [Api.GetFullName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/GetFullName.md): Returns the full name of the currently opened file.
- [Api.GetLastSlide](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/GetLastSlide.md): Returns the last slide of the presentation.
- [Api.GetPresentation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/GetPresentation.md): Returns the main presentation.
- [Api.GetSelection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/GetSelection.md): Returns the selection from the current presentation.
- [Api.GetSlideByIndex](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/GetSlideByIndex.md): Returns a slide by its position in the presentation.
- [Api.HexColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/HexColor.md): Creates a color from a HEX string.
- [Api.InchesToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/InchesToPoints.md): Converts inches to points.
- [Api.LinesToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/LinesToPoints.md): Converts lines to points (1 line = 12 points).
- [Api.MergeShapes](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/MergeShapes.md): Merges an array of drawings into new shapes. The resulting shapes take the formatting of the first drawing in the array.
- [Api.MillimetersToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToEmus.md): Converts millimeters to English Metric Units (EMUs).
- [Api.MillimetersToPixels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToPixels.md): Converts millimeters to pixels.
- [Api.MillimetersToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToPoints.md): Converts millimeters to points.
- [Api.PicasToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PicasToPoints.md): Converts picas to points.
- [Api.PixelsToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PixelsToEmus.md): Converts pixels to EMUs (English Metric Units).
- [Api.PixelsToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PixelsToPoints.md): Converts pixels to points.
- [Api.PointsToCentimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PointsToCentimeters.md): Converts points to centimeters.
- [Api.PointsToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PointsToEmus.md): Converts points to EMUs (English Metric Units).
- [Api.PointsToInches](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PointsToInches.md): Converts points to inches.
- [Api.PointsToLines](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PointsToLines.md): Converts points to lines (1 line = 12 points).
- [Api.PointsToMillimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PointsToMillimeters.md): Converts points to millimeters.
- [Api.PointsToPicas](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PointsToPicas.md): Converts points to picas (1 pica = 12 points).
- [Api.PointsToPixels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PointsToPixels.md): Converts points to pixels.
- [Api.PointsToTwips](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/PointsToTwips.md): Converts points to twips.
- [Api.RGB](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/RGB.md): Creates an RGB color from red, green and blue components.
- [Api.RGBA](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/RGBA.md): Creates an RGBA color from red, green, blue and alpha components.
- [Api.ReplaceTextSmart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/ReplaceTextSmart.md): Replaces each paragraph (or text in cell) in the select with the corresponding text from an array of strings.
- [Api.Save](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/Save.md): Saves changes to the specified document.
- [Api.ThemeColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/ThemeColor.md): Creates a theme color.
- [Api.TwipsToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/TwipsToPoints.md): Converts twips to points.
- [Api.attachEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/attachEvent.md): Subscribes to the specified event and calls the callback function when the event fires.
- [Api.detachEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Api/Methods/detachEvent.md): Unsubscribes from the specified event.

## ApiAnimationEffect

- [ApiAnimationEffect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect.md): Class representing an animation effect.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the animation effect.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns the type of the ApiAnimationEffect class.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.GetDelay](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/GetDelay.md): Returns the delay before the animation effect starts in milliseconds.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.GetDuration](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/GetDuration.md): Returns the duration of the animation effect in milliseconds.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.GetEffectType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/GetEffectType.md): Returns the animation effect type.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.GetRepeatCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/GetRepeatCount.md): Returns the repeat count for the animation effect.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.GetShape](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/GetShape.md): Returns the animated drawing object.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.GetTriggerType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/GetTriggerType.md): Returns the trigger type for the animation effect.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.MoveTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/MoveTo.md): Moves the animation effect to the specified position in the sequence.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.SetDelay](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/SetDelay.md): Sets the delay before the animation effect starts in milliseconds.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.SetDuration](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/SetDuration.md): Sets the duration of the animation effect in milliseconds.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.SetRepeatCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/SetRepeatCount.md): Sets the repeat count for the animation effect.
- [ApiAnimationEffect.SetTriggerType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationEffect/Methods/SetTriggerType.md): Sets the trigger type for the animation effect.

## ApiAnimationSequence

- [ApiAnimationSequence](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationSequence.md): Class representing an animation sequence (main sequence or interactive sequence).
- [ApiAnimationSequence.AddEffect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationSequence/Methods/AddEffect.md): Adds an animation effect to the sequence.
- [ApiAnimationSequence.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationSequence/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns the type of the ApiAnimationSequence class.
- [ApiAnimationSequence.GetCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationSequence/Methods/GetCount.md): Returns the number of effects in the sequence.
- [ApiAnimationSequence.GetEffect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationSequence/Methods/GetEffect.md): Returns the effect at the specified index.
- [ApiAnimationSequence.RemoveAllEffects](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiAnimationSequence/Methods/RemoveAllEffects.md): Removes all effects from the sequence.

## ApiBullet

- [ApiBullet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiBullet.md): Class representing a paragraph bullet.
- [ApiBullet.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiBullet/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiBullet class.
- [ApiBullet.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiBullet/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiBullet object into the JSON object.

## ApiChart

- [ApiChart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart.md): Class representing a chart.
- [ApiChart.ApplyChartStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/ApplyChartStyle.md): Sets a style to the current chart by style ID.
- [ApiChart.Copy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/Copy.md): Creates a copy of the current chart.
- [ApiChart.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the specified drawing object from the parent.
- [ApiChart.Fill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/Fill.md): Sets the fill formatting properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiChart.GetAllSeries](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetAllSeries.md): Returns all series from the chart space.
- [ApiChart.GetChartType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetChartType.md): Returns a type of the chart object.
- [ApiChart.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiChart class.
- [ApiChart.GetDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetDescription.md): Gets the description of the current drawing.
- [ApiChart.GetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetFill.md): Gets the fill formatting properties from the current graphic object.
- [ApiChart.GetFlipH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetFlipH.md): Get horizontal flip of current drawing.
- [ApiChart.GetFlipV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetFlipV.md): Get vertical flip of current drawing.
- [ApiChart.GetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetHeight.md): Returns the height of the current drawing.
- [ApiChart.GetHyperlink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetHyperlink.md): Returns the hyperlink from the current drawing object (shape or image).
- [ApiChart.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal ID of the current drawing object.
- [ApiChart.GetLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetLine.md): Gets the outline properties from the current graphic object.
- [ApiChart.GetLockAspect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetLockAspect.md): Returns whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.
- [ApiChart.GetLockValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetLockValue.md): Returns the lock value for the specified lock type of the current drawing.
- [ApiChart.GetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetName.md): Returns the name of the current drawing.
- [ApiChart.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the drawing parent object.
- [ApiChart.GetParentLayout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetParentLayout.md): Returns the drawing parent slide layout.
- [ApiChart.GetParentMaster](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetParentMaster.md): Returns the drawing parent slide master.
- [ApiChart.GetParentSlide](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetParentSlide.md): Returns the drawing parent slide.
- [ApiChart.GetPlaceholder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetPlaceholder.md): Returns a placeholder from the current drawing object.
- [ApiChart.GetPosX](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiChart/Methods/GetPosX.md): Gets the x position of the drawing on the slide.

## ApiPath

- [ApiPath](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath.md): Class representing a path in geometry.
- [ApiPath.ArcTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/ArcTo.md): Draws an arc from the current point using the specified width and height radii, start angle, and sweep angle.
- [ApiPath.Close](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/Close.md): Closes the current path.
- [ApiPath.CubicBezTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/CubicBezTo.md): Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using two control points.
- [ApiPath.GetCommand](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommand.md): Returns a specific path command by its index.
- [ApiPath.GetCommandCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommandCount.md): Returns the number of commands for the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetCommands](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommands.md): Returns all commands of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetFill.md): Returns the fill type of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetHeight.md): Returns the height of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetStroke.md): Returns true if the current path is stroked, otherwise false.
- [ApiPath.GetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetWidth.md): Returns the width of the current path.
- [ApiPath.LineTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/LineTo.md): Draws a line from the current point to the specified coordinates.
- [ApiPath.MoveTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/MoveTo.md): Moves the current path to the specified coordinates.
- [ApiPath.QuadBezTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/QuadBezTo.md): Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using a control point.
- [ApiPath.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the fill type to the current path.
- [ApiPath.SetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetHeight.md): Sets the height to the current path.
- [ApiPath.SetStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetStroke.md): Sets whether the current path is stroked.
- [ApiPath.SetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetWidth.md): Sets the width to the current path.

## ApiPathCommand

- [ApiPathCommand](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPathCommand.md): Class representing a path command.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetHR](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetHR.md): Returns the height radius of the arc.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetStartAngle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetStartAngle.md): Returns the start angle of the arc.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetSweepAngle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetSweepAngle.md): Returns the sweep angle of the arc.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetType.md): Returns the type of the current path command.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetWR](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetWR.md): Returns the width radius of the arc.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetX](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetX.md): Returns the X coordinate for the "moveTo"/"lineTo" path commands.

## ApiPresentationVisitor

- [ApiPresentationVisitor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPresentationVisitor.md): Class representing a presentation visitor. It walks slides, layouts, masters, speaker notes, drawings (including the drawings nested in groups, table cells and chart titles) and the paragraphs and runs of their text. Assign functions to the hooks to be notified; return true from a hook to skip the subtree of that node.
- [ApiPresentationVisitor.Stop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPresentationVisitor/Methods/Stop.md): Stops the traversal. No further hooks are called after the current one returns.
- [ApiPresentationVisitor.Traverse](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiPresentationVisitor/Methods/Traverse.md): Traverses the object the visitor was created from and calls the assigned hooks for every node.

The run must be attached to the document before calling this method.

- [ApiRun.SetFontFamily](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetFontFamily.md): Sets all 4 font slots with the specified font family.
- [ApiRun.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size to the characters of the current text run.
- [ApiRun.SetHighlight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetHighlight.md): Specifies a highlighting color which is added to the text properties and applied as a background to the contents of the current run/range/paragraph.
- [ApiRun.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.
- [ApiRun.SetLanguage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetLanguage.md): Specifies the languages which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing the contents of the text run.
- [ApiRun.SetOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetOutLine.md): Sets the text outline to the current text run.
- [ApiRun.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the small letter characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiRun.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiRun.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with a single horizontal line through the center of the line.
- [ApiRun.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces the whole text of the current run with the specified text, keeping the run properties.
- [ApiRun.SetTextFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetTextFill.md): Sets the text fill to the current text run.
- [ApiRun.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the current run.
- [ApiRun.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiRun.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the contents of the run in relation to the default appearance of the run text:

The "autoFit" type resizes the shape to fit the text, the "normAutoFit" type reduces the font size and line spacing to fit the text into the shape. The recalculation is performed after the script is executed. \This method is not supported in the document builder and works only in the editor.\

- [ApiTable.GetSelectedColumnsCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetSelectedColumnsCells.md): Returns all cells from the columns that contain the currently selected cells. This method identifies which columns contain selected cells and then returns all cells in those columns, not just the selected cells themselves.
- [ApiTable.GetSelectedRows](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetSelectedRows.md): Returns the rows that contain the currently selected cells of the current table.
- [ApiTable.GetShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetShadow.md): Returns the shadow of the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.GetTableDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableDescription.md): Returns the table description.
- [ApiTable.GetTableLook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableLook.md): Gets table look properties
- [ApiTable.GetTableTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTableTitle.md): Returns the table title.
- [ApiTable.GetTextRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTextRange.md): Returns an ApiTextRange covering the full text content of the shape. Creates a text body if the shape does not yet have one.
- [ApiTable.GetTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetTitle.md): Gets the title of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.GetVisitor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetVisitor.md): Returns a visitor object for traversing the text of the current drawing, including the drawings nested in a group.
- [ApiTable.GetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/GetWidth.md): Returns the width of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.HasTextContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/HasTextContent.md): Checks whether the drawing has an associated text body.
- [ApiTable.MergeCells](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/MergeCells.md): Merges an array of cells.
- [ApiTable.RemoveColumn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/RemoveColumn.md): Removes a table column with the specified cell.
- [ApiTable.RemoveRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/RemoveRow.md): Removes a table row with the specified cell. When the last row is removed, the whole table is deleted from the slide
- [ApiTable.ReplacePlaceholder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/ReplacePlaceholder.md): Replaces the placeholder by a drawing on the slide.
- [ApiTable.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/Select.md): Selects the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SelectRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SelectRange.md): Selects a range of cells in the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetBackgroundColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetBackgroundColor.md): Sets the background color for all cells in the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetColumnWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetColumnWidth.md): Sets the width of the specified column in the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetDescription.md): Sets the description of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the fill formatting properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SetFlipH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetFlipH.md): Sets the horizontal flip of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetFlipV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetFlipV.md): Sets the vertical flip of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetHeight.md): Sets the total height of the current table, distributing it evenly among the table rows. The value is applied as a minimum height for each row, so a row can be taller if its content requires more space.
- [ApiTable.SetHyperlink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetHyperlink.md): Sets a hyperlink to the current drawing object (shape or image).
- [ApiTable.SetLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetLine.md): Sets the outline properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SetLockAspect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetLockAspect.md): Sets whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.
- [ApiTable.SetLockValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetLockValue.md): Sets the lock value to the specified lock type of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetName.md): Sets the name of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.SetOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetOutLine.md): Sets the outline properties to the specified graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SetPlaceholder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetPlaceholder.md): Sets the specified placeholder to the current drawing object.
- [ApiTable.SetPosX](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetPosX.md): Sets the x position of the drawing on the slide.
- [ApiTable.SetPosY](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetPosY.md): Sets the y position of the drawing on the slide.
- [ApiTable.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetPosition.md): Sets the position of the drawing on the slide.
- [ApiTable.SetRotation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetRotation.md): Sets the rotation angle to the current drawing object.
- [ApiTable.SetShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetShadow.md): Sets the shadow to the current graphic object.
- [ApiTable.SetShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetShd.md): Specifies the shading which shall be applied to the extents of the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetSize.md): Sets the table size.
- [ApiTable.SetStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetStyle.md): Sets the style for the current table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableDescription.md): Sets the table description.
- [ApiTable.SetTableLook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableLook.md): Specifies the components of the conditional formatting of the referenced table style (if one exists) which shall be applied to the set of table rows with the current table-level property exceptions. A table style can specify up to six different optional conditional formats [Example: Different formatting for first column], which then can be applied or omitted from individual table rows in the parent table.
- [ApiTable.SetTableTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTableTitle.md): Sets the table title.
- [ApiTable.SetTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/SetTitle.md): Sets the title of the current drawing.
- [ApiTable.ToJSON](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/ToJSON.md): Converts the ApiTable object into the JSON object.
- [ApiTable.Unselect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTable/Methods/Unselect.md): Removes the current graphic object from the selection.

- [ApiTableCell.SetCellMarginLeft](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellMarginLeft.md): Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the left extent of the current cell contents and the left edge border of a specific individual table cell within a table.

- [ApiTableCell.SetCellMarginTop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetCellMarginTop.md): Specifies an amount of space which shall be left between the top extent of the current cell contents and the top edge border of a specific individual table cell within a table.

- [ApiTableCell.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces all content of the current table cell with the specified text, preserving the formatting of the first paragraph.
- [ApiTableCell.SetTextDirection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTableCell/Methods/SetTextDirection.md): Specifies the direction of the text flow for the current table cell.

- [ApiTextPr.SetCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetCaps.md): Specifies that any lowercase characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.
- [ApiTextPr.SetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetColor.md): Sets the text color to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetDoubleStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetDoubleStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.
- [ApiTextPr.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the text color to the current text run.

- [ApiTextPr.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size to the characters of the current text run.

- [ApiTextPr.SetOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetOutLine.md): Sets the text outline to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the small letter characters in the text run are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiTextPr.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiTextPr.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed with a single horizontal line through the center of the line.
- [ApiTextPr.SetTextFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetTextFill.md): Sets the text fill to the current text run.
- [ApiTextPr.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of the run are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiTextPr.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the contents of the run in relation to the default appearance of the run text:

## ApiTextRange

- [ApiTextRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange.md): Class representing a text range within a presentation shape's text frame.
- [ApiTextRange.AddHyperlink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/AddHyperlink.md): Adds a hyperlink to the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.AddText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/AddText.md): Adds a text to the specified position. The current range is expanded to include the added text.
- [ApiTextRange.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.ExpandTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/ExpandTo.md): Returns a new range that spans both this range and the given range. The current range is not changed.
- [ApiTextRange.Find](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Find.md): Finds the first occurrence of the given text within this range and returns it as a new ApiTextRange. Returns null if the text is not found.
- [ApiTextRange.GetAllParagraphs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetAllParagraphs.md): Returns all Paragraph objects within this range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns the class type identifier.
- [ApiTextRange.GetEndPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetEndPos.md): Returns the end position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetParagraph.md): Returns the paragraph at the given index within this range. Returns null if the index is out of bounds.
- [ApiTextRange.GetRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetRange.md): Returns a new ApiTextRange that represents a sub-range of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetStartPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetStartPos.md): Returns the start position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the text content of the range. Paragraph breaks are represented as "\r".
- [ApiTextRange.GetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetTextPr.md): Returns the merged text properties of the entire range.
- [ApiTextRange.IntersectWith](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/IntersectWith.md): Returns a new range that is the intersection of this range and the given range. The current range is not changed.
- [ApiTextRange.MoveCursorToPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/MoveCursorToPos.md): Moves a cursor to the specified position within the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.Replace](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Replace.md): Replaces all occurrences of the specified text within this range.
- [ApiTextRange.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Select.md): Selects the text range in the editor.
- [ApiTextRange.SetBold](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetBold.md): Sets bold formatting for the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetCaps.md): Specifies that any lowercase characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.
- [ApiTextRange.SetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetColor.md): Sets the text color of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetDoubleStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetDoubleStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with two horizontal lines through each character displayed on the line.
- [ApiTextRange.SetEndPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetEndPos.md): Sets the end position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetFontFamily](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetFontFamily.md): Sets the font family for the current TextRange.
- [ApiTextRange.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size of the characters in the current text Range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetHighlight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetHighlight.md): Specifies a highlighting color which is applied as a background to the contents of the current Range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.
- [ApiTextRange.SetLanguage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetLanguage.md): Specifies the language which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the lowercase letter characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiTextRange.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiTextRange.SetStartPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetStartPos.md): Sets the start position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with a single horizontal line through the range center.
- [ApiTextRange.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces all text content with the given string. Use "\r" to separate paragraphs.
- [ApiTextRange.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiTextRange.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the Range contents in relation to the default appearance of the Range text: "baseline" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned by the default text baseline. "subscript" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned below the default text baseline. "superscript" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned above the default text baseline.
- [ApiTextRange.ToHtml](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/ToHtml.md): Converts the text range to HTML.

- [BulletType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/BulletType.md): A bullet type which will be added to the paragraph in spreadsheet or presentation.
- [ChartType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ChartType.md): This type specifies the available chart types which can be used to create a new chart.
- [ChartTypeLegacy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ChartTypeLegacy.md): This type specifies the legacy chart type names which are kept for backward compatibility.
- [CustomXmlNodeAttribute](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/CustomXmlNodeAttribute.md): Represents an attribute of an XML node.
- [DashType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/DashType.md): Available dash type for line.
- [DocumentElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/DocumentElement.md): Any valid element which can be added to the document structure.
- [Drawing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/Drawing.md): Any valid drawing element.
- [DrawingForGroup](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/DrawingForGroup.md): Available drawing element for grouping.
- [DrawingLockType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/DrawingLockType.md): This type specifies the type of drawing lock.
- [EMU](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/EMU.md): English measure unit. 1 mm = 36000 EMUs, 1 inch = 914400 EMUs.
- [EntryEffect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/EntryEffect.md): The available slide transition effects.
- [FillType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/FillType.md): The available fill types.
- [GeometryCoordinate](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/GeometryCoordinate.md): The coordinate value for the geometry paths.
- [GeometryFormulaType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/GeometryFormulaType.md): This type specifies the formula type that will be used for a geometry guide.
- [LayoutType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/LayoutType.md): Available layout types.
- [LineCapType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/LineCapType.md): The line cap type.
- [LineEndSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/LineEndSize.md): The line end size.
- [LineEndType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/LineEndType.md): The line end type.
- [LineJoinType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/LineJoinType.md): The line join type.
- [NumFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/NumFormat.md): Standard numeric format.
- [ParagraphContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ParagraphContent.md): The types of elements that can be added to the paragraph structure.
- [PathCommandType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/PathCommandType.md): The path command types.
- [PathFillType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/PathFillType.md): The path fill type.
- [PatternType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/PatternType.md): The available preset patterns which can be used for the fill.
- [PlaceholderType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/PlaceholderType.md): Available placeholder types.
- [PositiveFixedAngle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/PositiveFixedAngle.md): 60000th of a degree (5400000 = 90 degrees).
- [PositivePercentage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/PositivePercentage.md): The 1000th of a percent (100000 = 100%).
- [PresetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/PresetColor.md): The available preset color names.
- [SchemeColorId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/SchemeColorId.md): The available color scheme identifiers.

- [ShadowSettings](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ShadowSettings.md): Properties used to create a shadow.
- [ShapeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ShapeType.md): This type specifies the preset shape geometry that will be used for a shape.
- [ShapesMergeOperation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ShapesMergeOperation.md): The operation used to merge shapes.
- [ShdType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ShdType.md): A shade type which can be added to the document element.
- [StyleType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/StyleType.md): The style type used for the document element.
- [TabJc](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/TabJc.md): Types of custom tab.
- [TabStop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/TabStop.md): A paragraph tab stop.
- [TableLook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/TableLook.md): No description provided.
- [TableStyleOverrideType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/TableStyleOverrideType.md): This simple type specifies possible values for the table sections to which the current conditional formatting properties will be applied when this selected table style is used.
- [TextFitType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/TextFitType.md): The available text autofit types inside a shape.

- [ThemeFontScript](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ThemeFontScript.md): The available scripts of a theme font: "latin" - the latin text, "ea" - the east asian text, "cs" - the complex script text.
- [TickLabelPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/TickLabelPosition.md): Possible values for the position of chart tick labels (either horizontal or vertical).
- [TickMark](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/TickMark.md): The available types of tick mark appearance.
- [ToHtmlOptions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/ToHtmlOptions.md): Options for converting document content to an HTML string.
- [TransitionSpeed](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/TransitionSpeed.md): The available slide transition speed values.
- [VerticalTextAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/VerticalTextAlign.md): The available text vertical alignment (used to align text in a shape with a placement for text inside it).
- [byte](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/byte.md): A numeric value from 0 to 255.
- [highlightColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/highlightColor.md): Available highlight colors.
- [hps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/hps.md): Half-points (2 half-points = 1 point).
- [line240](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/line240.md): 240ths of a line.
- [mm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/mm.md): 1 millimetre equals 1/10th of a centimetre.
- [twips](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/presentation-api/Enumeration/twips.md): Twentieths of a point (equivalent to 1/1440th of an inch).
